title: "About the Centre"
pagetitle: "About"
---

The Centre for Household Finance is a research centre in the
[Department of Economics](https://www.ekon.sun.ac.za) at
[Stellenbosch University](https://www.sun.ac.za). Household finance is the study
of how, and how successfully, households use financial instruments to achieve
their goals. We combine economic theory, knowledge of South Africa's
institutions and history, and survey and administrative data to address
questions in this field: how consumer financial markets work, and which
policies would make them work more efficiently and more equitably.

Our current work covers mortgage pricing, funeral insurance, and financial
information and advice. The [Research](../research/index.qmd) page describes
each theme and lists our papers.

## Governance

The Centre operates under a constitution approved by the Faculty and a Research
Charter that governs research independence, data governance, and our
relationships with funders and data partners. Both are published in full on the
[Governance](governance.qmd) page.
